fields.Name: T283 - Home Configure Action Pin Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises OpenActionPinConfig() → the mj-action-pin-config-dialog component, the special 'Actions' resource type that requires configuration before pinning — a distinct dialog code path from the direct Pin buttons on other resource types.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Go to the Home landing page (Home icon/logo or application switcher dropdown). In the 'Pinned' section click 'Add Pin' to open the slide-in panel and wait for it to load. Look for a 'Quick Actions' accordion section. If present, expand it and click the 'Configure' button (sliders icon) on any action item. Verify that an action-pin configuration dialog opens, allowing you to set up the action before pinning (title/theming/parameters). Seeing the configuration dialog appear is success — you do NOT need to complete the configuration. If there is no 'Quick Actions' section because no actions are available, the Home page rendering the panel cleanly without that section is an acceptable pass. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: If a 'Quick Actions' section is present, clicking 'Configure' on an action opens the action-pin configuration dialog
If no actions are available, the Add Pin panel still renders correctly without a Quick Actions section (valid empty case)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
